selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who is the only true God named in this passage?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What two things work together in this passage to show Allah is real and One?
questions.answer: True messages from Allah and true inspirations.

questions.question: What do the true messages from Allah show about Him?
questions.answer: They show that He truly exists and that He is One.

questions.question: What is one thing these true messages include?
questions.answer: Allah speaks to His servants.

questions.question: How does Allah respond to people in the passage?
questions.answer: He answers their prayers with mercy.

questions.question: What do true inspirations show about Allah’s care?
questions.answer: They show His love and His help.

questions.question: When servants call for help, what does Allah do in the passage?
questions.answer: He gives help to them.

questions.question: What does Allah let His creatures feel or notice about Him?
questions.answer: That He is there.

questions.question: Why are both revelation and inspiration important in this passage?
questions.answer: Both point to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: Many true signs show that Allah alone is the one true God.

questions.question: What big truth is said at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Only Allah is God.

questions.question: What kind of agreement do all true revelations have?
questions.answer: They all give the same proof about Allah.

questions.question: What do they agree on about Allah?
questions.answer: That He must exist and that He is One.

questions.question: Besides revelation, what else agrees with it?
questions.answer: True inspiration also agrees.

questions.question: What do these inspirations show about Allah’s feelings toward His creatures?
questions.answer: He loves them.

questions.question: What do these inspirations show Allah does when people pray?
questions.answer: He answers them.

questions.question: What do they show Allah does when His servants cry out for help?
questions.answer: He sends support.

questions.question: What is one way Allah lets His creatures know about Him?
questions.answer: He gives them signs of His presence.

questions.question: What should a Muslim child learn from this passage?
questions.answer: Allah is One, and He cares for His creatures.

questions.question: How does this passage show Allah is close to His creatures?
questions.answer: He answers, helps, and lets them know He is there.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s existence?
questions.answer: His existence is certain and necessary.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about how many gods there are?
questions.answer: There is only one God.

questions.question: What do Allah’s true messages contain besides commands?
questions.answer: They include His speaking and His making Himself known.

questions.question: What do true inspirations agree about?
questions.answer: They agree that Allah exists and is One.
